name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell on upper back. Brace core, descend until thighs parallel to floor, drive through heels to stand.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Hold barbell in front rack position. Squat to parallel while keeping torso upright.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position shoulders under pads, feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower until 90 degrees, press back up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Seat yourself, feet hip-width on platform. Lower platform until knees at 90 degrees, press back up.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench. Hold dumbbells and lower until front thigh is parallel to floor.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust seat so knees align with pivot. Extend legs fully, squeeze quads at top.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into lunge position, lower back knee toward floor, then step through with opposite leg.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold barbell at hip level. Hinge at hips, lowering bar along legs until hamstring stretch, drive hips forward to stand.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down, place ankles under pad. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze at top.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit with thighs resting on pad. Pull heels down and back, squeeze at bottom.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Barbell on upper back. Hinge at hips with soft knees until torso near parallel to floor.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back against bench, barbell across hips. Drive hips up until body forms straight line.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Drive hips up, squeezing glutes at top.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Attach ankle cuff to cable. Hinge forward, kick leg back and up, squeeze glute at peak.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on calf raise machine. Lower heels below platform, then raise up onto toes as high as possible.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with knees bent, pad across thighs. Lower heels, then drive up onto toes.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Bend at waist with hands braced. Have partner sit on lower back. Raise up on toes.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, grip barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower to chest, press back up.

name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees. Press barbell from upper chest upward.

name: Decline Barbell Press
instructions: Set bench to -15 to -30 degrees. Press barbell from lower chest.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells. Press up and slightly inward, lower with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees. Press dumbbells from upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Flye
instructions: Lie on bench, arms slightly bent. Lower dumbbells in wide arc, then bring together above chest.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between cable towers. Pull handles down and together in front of body.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit at machine, grip handles at chest level. Press forward until arms extended.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders. Lower chest to floor, press back up maintaining straight body.

name: Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars, lean forward slightly. Lower until shoulders below elbows, press back up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot. Grip just outside legs, brace core, push floor away as you pull bar up.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Wide stance, toes out. Grip inside legs. Drive hips through, pulling bar up.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, back flat. Pull barbell to lower abdomen, lead with elbows.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Back parallel to floor. Explosively row barbell to lower chest, reset to floor each rep.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place hand and knee on bench. Pull dumbbell to hip, squeeze back at top.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at cable row machine. Pull handle to lower abdomen, squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar wider than shoulders. Pull bar to upper chest, drive elbows down and back.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Grip bar shoulder-width, overhand. Pull body up until chin above bar.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grip bar shoulder-width, underhand. Pull body up until chin above bar.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle T-bar row machine. Pull handle to chest, keeping back flat.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit at machine, chest against pad. Row handles to sides, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Cable at face height with rope. Pull to face level, separating hands, externally rotating.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing high cable, arms extended. Pull bar down to hips with straight arms.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Rack barbell at chest height. Press overhead until arms fully extended, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press up until arms extended, lower back.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of face, palms in. Rotate palms out as you press overhead.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor, lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to cable. Pull handle from hip out to shoulder height.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both arms to shoulder height.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold barbell with narrow grip. Pull to chin level, leading with elbows.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit at machine, grip handles at shoulder height. Press up until arms extended.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand with barbell at hip level, underhand grip. Curl to shoulder height, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Curl alternately or together to shoulder height.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip. Curl to shoulder height without rotating wrist.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lie on incline bench, arms hanging. Curl dumbbells to shoulders, maximizing stretch at bottom.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing low cable. Curl bar or rope to shoulder height, squeeze at top.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Arms over preacher pad. Curl from full extension to chin height.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Grip EZ-bar at angled section. Curl to shoulder height, lower slowly.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated, rest upper arm against inner thigh. Curl dumbbell to shoulder.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip barbell shoulder-width. Lower to lower chest, press up, keeping elbows close to body.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: High cable with bar or rope. Push down until arms fully extended, keeping elbows at sides.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head, extend back up.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench, arms vertical. Lower bar to forehead by bending elbows, extend back up.

name: Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to floor. Extend forearm back until arm straight.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Form diamond shape with hands directly under chest. Perform push-up.

name: Cable Overhead Extension
instructions: Face away from high cable. Extend arms overhead with rope.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell at hip level. Shrug shoulders straight up, hold briefly, lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders toward ears, pause at top.

name: Plank
instructions: Support on forearms and toes, body straight. Hold position, bracing core.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Curl shoulders toward knees, squeezing abs.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise legs to parallel or higher, keeping them straight or slightly bent.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing high cable with rope. Pull elbows toward knees, crunching abs.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel holding wheel. Roll forward until extended, then pull back with core.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated, lean back at 45 degrees. Rotate torso side to side, optionally holding weight.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, hands by head. Bring opposite elbow and knee together, alternating sides.

name: Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat, raise both legs to 90 degrees, lower slowly without touching floor.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Support on one forearm and foot, body straight. Hold position.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Pull bar from floor explosively, extend hips and shrug, then drop under bar in front rack.

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Start with bar at hip level. Explosively extend hips, shrug and pull under into front rack.

name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Clean the bar to front rack, then jerk overhead by dipping and driving.

name: Snatch
instructions: Wide grip. Pull bar from floor to overhead in one movement, dropping under into overhead squat.

name: Thruster
instructions: Front squat into overhead press in one fluid movement.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell back between legs, then explosively drive hips forward.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold kettlebell at chest, squat to depth, keeping chest tall.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
instructions: From lying with arm extended, stand up while keeping arm vertical, then reverse.

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Hinge and swing kettlebell, then clean to rack position.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold band at shoulder height. Pull band apart until straight, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Resistance Band Squat
instructions: Stand on band, hold ends at shoulders. Squat to depth.

name: Treadmill
instructions: Walk or run at desired speed and incline. Maintain upright posture.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with legs first, lean back slightly, then pull handle to lower chest.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust seat height, pedal at target cadence.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Maintain smooth stride, use handles for upper body engagement.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step at steady pace, avoid leaning on rails.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Jump with both feet, turning rope with wrists.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand in front of box. Swing arms and jump onto box, landing softly with bent knees.

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Swing arms and jump forward as far as possible, landing with bent knees.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop to push-up, perform push-up, jump feet to hands, explosively jump up.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, then jump back together.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in push-up position. Rapidly alternate driving knees toward chest.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean forward on dip bars. Lower until upper arms parallel, press back.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Use assisted pull-up machine, set counterweight. Pull to chin over bar.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set pins at knee level. Pull bar from pins to full hip extension.

name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on small platform. Pull bar with increased range of motion.

name: Paused Squat
instructions: Descend into squat, pause 2-3 seconds at bottom, then drive back up.

name: Box Squat
instructions: Squat to box until fully seated, pause briefly, then stand.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest. Squat deep, keeping elbows inside knees.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step up onto box with one foot, drive through heel to stand, step back down.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with feet anchored. Lower body toward floor with control, push back up.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach ankle cuff, face pulley. Kick leg straight back and up.

name: Hyperextension
instructions: Position hips at pad edge. Lower torso, then raise back until body is straight.

name: Landmine Row
instructions: Anchor barbell in corner. Hinge and row bar to chest.

name: Chest Supported Row
instructions: Lie chest on incline pad. Row handles to sides.

name: Incline Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lie chest on incline bench. Row both dumbbells to hips.

name: Wide-Grip Pulldown
instructions: Wide overhand grip. Pull bar to upper chest.

name: Close-Grip Pulldown
instructions: Narrow neutral grip. Pull bar to chin level.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Slight bend in elbows, raise arms to sides until parallel with floor.

name: Bent-Over Lateral Raise
instructions: Hinge at hips, arms hanging. Raise dumbbells to sides until parallel.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Rope at face height. Pull to face, separating hands, rotating externally.

name: Machine Fly
instructions: Sit at pec deck, arms on pads. Bring arms together in front of chest.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench. Curl dumbbells with arms hanging straight down.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Overhand grip on barbell. Curl to shoulder height.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms on bench, wrists hanging off edge. Curl wrists up.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Between parallel bars, body upright. Dip until elbows at 90 degrees.

name: Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on bench. Lower dumbbells to sides of head by bending elbows, extend.

name: Push-Down with Rope
instructions: Rope attachment, high cable. Push down and slightly apart at bottom.

name: Reverse Grip Bench Press
instructions: Underhand grip, slightly narrower than shoulder width. Press bar from lower chest.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Seated, back supported. Press dumbbells from shoulder height overhead.

name: Push Press
instructions: Slight knee dip then explosively press bar overhead.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust (Elevated)
instructions: Upper back on elevated bench. Drive hips up with barbell across hips.

name: Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Balance on one leg. Hinge forward with free leg extending back, return to start.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand perpendicular to cable. Press handle straight out, resist rotation, return.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back, arms and legs extended upward. Lower opposite arm and leg, return.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: On hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg, hold, return.

name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbell on one side. Walk maintaining upright posture.

name: Farmers Walk
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides. Walk with upright posture.
